comment:
Plot 0 (the street, the sunken rink, Prometheus and the ring of flags) reads right: keep it exactly. Plot 1, THE CHANNEL GARDENS, is the foreground of the hero view from over Fifth Avenue and reads as a grey paved strip with six small dark boxes:
1. Make the six POOLS long and calm: each about 7 long (x) and 4 wide (z), with low pale granite rims (smooth stone / polished diorite slabs, not black), filled with water, a bronze fountain jet (a copper or lightning-rod spout with a water source) at each pool's west end; pools centred on the strip's axis in a row from near the east end to near the west end, short paved cross-walks between them.
2. Either side of the pools, long continuous PLANTERS about 3 wide running the length of the gardens, raised one slab with pale granite curbs, packed with colour: blocks of flowering azalea and azalea bushes, clipped box hedges (leaves), and dense beds of flowers in bands (tulips red/orange/white/pink, alliums, cornflowers, oxeye daisies, peonies and rose bushes), so from the air the strip reads as a bright green-and-flower runner between the two buildings.
3. The paved walks along both building faces 3 wide in pale granite, with a few benches and slim lamp posts every 8 blocks; the walks slope gently down toward the plaza with slabs, no raw steps.
Keep the box, the ground heights at the edges and plot 0 unchanged.
summary: I rebuilt plot 1, the Channel Gardens. It now has six long, calm pools with pale slab rims and turquoise floors, and a copper jet at each pool's west end. Either side runs a flower-and-shrub planter behind a pale curb, between 3-wide pale walks with benches and the existing lamps. Plot 0 is unchanged: comparing it cell by cell with v1 found 0 differences, and the box and edge heights are kept. The changes are in parts/garden-layout.mjs (new), parts/gardens.mjs and plot1() in parts/ground.mjs. The build runs with no refused writes, and the light check finds no dark cells on plot 1.
applied: Pools: P1 x58..64, P2 66..72, P3 75..81, P4 83..89, P5 91..96, P6 99..105. They are 4 wide (z 6..9) on the strip's centre line and run from near the east end to near the west end. Each has a low smooth_stone_slab rim (pale, not black), still water 2 wide, and a prismarine_bricks floor. Paved cross-walks between them are at x 65, 82 and 90, and the half-step bands are at x 73..74 and 97..98.
Fountain jets: a waxed_exposed_copper block stands in the water at each pool's west end with a lightning_rod spout on top.

Planters: two long runners, north z 3..5 and south z 10..12. Each has a pale smooth_stone_slab curb raised one slab on the walk side and at the ends, and the pool rim serves as the inner edge. The soil is grass and moss. They run continuously along each terrace (x 57..72, 75..96, 99..106) and only break at the two half-step bands. Planting is in 3-long bands: flowering azalea and azalea leaf bushes, oak-leaf box hedge, tulips (red, orange, white, pink), alliums, cornflowers, oxeye daisies, and tall peonies, rose bushes and lilacs. From the air the strip now reads as a green-and-flower runner (checked in a render from over Fifth Avenue).

Walks: 3 wide (z 0..2 and 13..15) in pale smooth_stone with polished_andesite cross bands. There are 12 polished_andesite_stairs benches, mid-pool, backed on the curbs. The existing slim lamp posts stay at roughly 8-block spacing on z 2 and z 13.

Slope: the walks climb in half-slab steps at x 73..74 and 97..98. I also added smooth_stone_slab half steps on the south edge rows (z 14..15, x 75..76 and 99..100), where the mapped edge heights left raw full-block steps. This means those edge cells now carry a half slab above their mapped height.

Inspected: check finds no floating blocks and no new orphans; the 3 orphans it lists are the existing gold in Prometheus on plot 0. The palette flags are all in the kept plot 0 (gold, birch_fence). I rendered the build and looked at the gardens from the north, from over Fifth Avenue and from the corners.
skipped: Pool size: five pools are 7 long but P5 is 6 long (x 91..96). The middle terrace (x 75..96, 22 blocks) can't fit three 7-long pools plus cross-walks, and a pool can't straddle a level change.
Planter width: each planter is 3 wide including its curb, so there are 2 rows of soil. A third soil row would have taken the 3-wide walks, which you also asked for.
Jet water: there's no separate water source on top of the spout, because one there would spill over the low rim onto the walks and planters. The jet stands in the pool's still water instead.

The 15 dark cells the light check lists are all in plot 0 (the edge street cells and around the Prometheus mount). They were already there in v1 and I left them, since you asked to keep plot 0 exactly.
